requirements.CBH01: Keep the Create challenge Back caption fully visible through hover, press and keyboard focus.
requirements.Q01: Preserve concurrent changes and retain a scoped Git-checkable patch.

cause: The transparent normal style reserved 4px per side while shared hover/pressed/focus used 12px. Godot sized Back to 45px from normal, leaving insufficient space for the hovered caption (Ba).
change: Use the shared default 12px padding for the transparent normal style. Button is now 61x52 with an unchanged right edge and stable dimensions across states.
